{{Quote|The tracking station in Pastil is fully operational.|Cody, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
The '''Pastil tracking station''' was a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located on [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was operated by [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|I didn't think you could get a com-station ''this'' clean. It's shinier than these rookies.|Rex, to Cody|<ref name="MH" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Rookies" /><ref name="Rookies Date" /> [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] inspected the [[Listening post/Legends|tracking station]] on [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]].<ref name="MH" /> During their inspection, they [[Skirmish on Pastil|uncovered]] a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]],<ref name="TOSVC32" /> a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] that was nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" by the [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed on Pastil.<ref name="MH" />

Following their inspection, Marshal Commander Cody and Captain Rex reported to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the tracking station was fully operational, and proceeded to the [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]], where they [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|prevented]] a major [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursion.<ref name="Rookies" />
